RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts

An all-male panel is worth raising as a question about recruitment safeguards, not as proof of discrimination. It does not establish that sex influenced this decision.

Your longer experience and deputy role justify asking how candidates were assessed, but digital expertise could legitimately outweigh years served if relevant to the advertised criteria.

Follow up in writing requesting the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and how the panel ensured fairness. Ask whether panel composition complied with the broadcaster’s recruitment and equality policies.

Keep records. If you may challenge the outcome, consult your union or a local equality adviser promptly: deadlines vary and may run while you await an explanation.
